biggest_catch: Earnings are entirely variable - you earn only when your photos sell, and you must drive your own traffic; no guaranteed income.
catches: You set your own image prices; per Picfair's official blog/pricing guide Picfair adds its 20% commission on top of your price at checkout so you receive your full set price. Note: current Picfair marketing (try.picfair.com) says Plus stores take zero commission on sales - the commission model appears to have shifted toward the Plus subscription.
No audition or quality gate - anyone can sign up and upload free of charge
Single simple license; corporate branding use excluded

Picfair Plus is a paid subscription and a separate cost: provider's own page (try.picfair.com, observed 2026-09-23) offers 30 days free, then £4.50/€5.50/$6 for the first month or £45/€53/$60 for the first year. Factor this in when deciding if sales justify the service.
You keep full copyright of your images; non-exclusive
